name: Tactical Fighter
source:
One rainy day a daughter of the director of a company visited the hero. She said that the company was hijacked, director was missing. In order to help director the hero starts to train this 15-year old girl in  order to win in S-Grand Prix fighting competition in three years time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
